note: Screening of the OPENING: 24 fresh medium maps (Skirmish M and Balance M of the fresh1 pool), both seats, played to day 42 - 768 games. Why: in the third screening (383 games to the end, 74 % won) FairAI's main army was about twice the strongest enemy hero's from day 21 on, in won and lost games alike, yet wins came on day 109 (median) and 74 of the 100 losses fell on 9 of the 24 seats - seats on which FairAI sits still in the first four weeks (on one of them 16 % of the map seen from day 7 to day 28, three guards beaten, two mines, with an army of 65,000) while Nullkiller2 beats twice as many guards, sees a third more of the map and holds a town more by day 42. Logged games show the main hero walking between its town and its work every three days to fetch the week's troops, past packs of pixies that guard mines. What a side has on day 28 and 42 is measured in every game and varies little: the third screening showed the old fight forecast to cost 1.6 +- 0.8 mines and 0.3 +- 0.2 towns by day 28 (dev_effects.py), where the win rate said nothing. Thirteen probe games with all eight switches on against the base: by day 42 guards beaten 23.3 instead of 18.5, map seen 49 % instead of 39 %, towns 3.1 instead of 2.6, best hero level 11.0 instead of 9.5, army 186,000 instead of 175,000 (the detour switch alone: nothing to see). The base holds the combat package of 19.11. (battlePlan 3, guardModel, ownCasters, wholeCreatures). B = breakout 3: a main hero with nothing worth its army to do for three days values guards with unseen land behind them as ways out. Y = supplyRuns 1: a hero brings what has grown in a town to the main hero, which then does not walk home. H = fetchByShare + fetchRoundTrip: troops waiting in a town count by what they add to the main hero's army, and the way home counts twice. D = detour (new): what lies on the way is taken on the way. F = fightForecast + forecastPlans: fights against guards judged by the simulated battle, played as the combat AI plays it. L = lossAversion 0.6: losses against guards weigh less. E = expValueMain 1.2 + guardKillValue 0.2: experience and beaten guards weigh more. X = scouts 2: two more heroes that explore. Design: eight switches or groups of switches on the base {"magicWorth": 2, "battlePlan": 3, "guardModel": 1, "ownCasters": 1, "wholeCreatures": 1}, 2^(8-4) resolution IV, shared pool; B = breakout 3; Y = supplyRuns 1; H = fetchByShare 1 + fetchRoundTrip 1; D = detour 1; F = fightForecast 1 + forecastPlans 1; L = lossAversion 0.6; E = expValueMain 1.2 + guardKillValue 0.2; X = scouts 2. Evaluate with arena/dev_effects.py (and arena/effects.py for the army share at the day limit): --factors '{"B": {"breakout": 3}, "Y": {"supplyRuns": 1}, "H": {"fetchByShare": 1, "fetchRoundTrip": 1}, "D": {"detour": 1}, "F": {"fightForecast": 1, "forecastPlans": 1}, "L": {"lossAversion": 0.6}, "E": {"expValueMain": 1.2, "guardKillValue": 0.2}, "X": {"scouts": 2}}' (configurations named by the letters that are on; 'base' = the base alone).
